title: Unit 3: Key Vocabulary & Terminology (Part 1) 📚
content: 📌 Welcome to the EthioFresh Family! 👋✨ In this section, we examine the core vocabulary words from Unit 3 along with their detailed definitions, synonyms, antonyms, and practical contextual examples. ========================================= 1. Culture (Noun) 🏛️ ========================================= • Definition: The customs, arts, social institutions, and achievements of a particular nation, people, or social group. • Amharic Translation: ባህል / የህብረተሰብ ልማድ • Synonyms: Heritage, Tradition, Customs • Antonyms: Barbarism, Unculturedness • Example: Respecting different cultural values fosters unity among diverse communities. ========================================= 2. Cultural Values (Noun Phrase) 🤝 ========================================= • Definition: The core principles and ideals upon which an entire community exists and functions. • Amharic Translation: የባህል እሴቶች / ማህበራዊ መመሪያዎች • Synonyms: Core beliefs, Principles, Standards • Antonyms: Deviance, Normlessness • Example: Hospitality and mutual support are strong cultural values in Ethiopia.

title: Unit 3: Key Vocabulary & Terminology (Part 2) ⚖️
content: 📌 3. Egalitarianism (Noun) ⚖️ • Definition: The doctrine or belief that all people are equal and deserve equal rights and opportunities. • Amharic Translation: እኩልነት / ሁሉም ሰው እኩል ነው የሚል እምነት • Synonyms: Equality, Fairness, Justness • Antonyms: Elitism, Discrimination, Inequality • Example: The Awramba community was founded on the principles of egalitarianism. ========================================= 4. Subservient (Adjective) 🙇‍♂️ ========================================= • Definition: Prepared to obey others unquestioningly; less important or subordinate. • Amharic Translation: ተገዢ / ዝቅ ያለ / አዛዥ የሚጠብቅ • Synonyms: Subordinate, Obedient, Passive • Antonyms: Dominant, Independent, Masterful • Example: Awramba promotes gender equality where women are not subservient to men. ========================================= 5. Ostracized (Verb / Adjective) 🚫 ========================================= • Definition: Excluded or banished from a society, group, or community. • Amharic Translation: የተገለለ / የተገፋ • Synonyms: Excluded, Isolated, Shunned • Antonyms: Welcomed, Accepted, Included • Example: The community was ostracized because their lifestyle differed from surrounding groups.

title: Unit 3: Key Vocabulary & Terminology (Part 3) 🌟
content: 📌 6. Lauded (Verb / Adjective) 👏 • Definition: Highly praised or admired publicly. • Amharic Translation: የተመሰገነ / የጸደቀ • Synonyms: Praised, Extolled, Acclaimed • Antonyms: Criticized, Condemned, Blamed • Example: Awramba is lauded as a successful model for poverty reduction. ========================================= 7. Alleviate (Verb) 🛠️ ========================================= • Definition: To make suffering, pain, or a problem less severe or easier to bear. • Amharic Translation: ማቃለል / መቀነስ • Synonyms: Reduce, Ease, Relieve • Antonyms: Aggravate, Worsen, Increase • Example: Hard work and community projects help alleviate poverty in rural areas. ========================================= 8. Diligent (Adjective) 💼 ========================================= • Definition: Showing care, steady effort, and conscientiousness in work or duties. • Amharic Translation: ትጉህ / ሰራተኛ • Synonyms: Hardworking, Conscientious, Assiduous • Antonyms: Lazy, Careless, Negligent • Example: The diligent work ethic of the community members led to their economic success.

title: Unit 3: Key Vocabulary & Terminology (Part 4) 🎯
content: 📌 9. Obscene (Adjective) 🛑 • Definition: Offensive or disgusting by accepted standards of morality and decency. • Amharic Translation: ነውረኛ / በጣም የሚጠላ • Synonyms: Offensive, Repulsive, Abhorrent • Antonyms: Decent, Respectable, Proper • Example: In their community, theft and dishonesty are viewed as highly obscene. ========================================= 10. Endeavor (Noun / Verb) 🚀 ========================================= • Definition: An earnest, prolonged, or industrious attempt to achieve a goal. • Amharic Translation: ጥረት / ተግባር • Synonyms: Attempt, Effort, Venture • Antonyms: Inaction, Idleness, Passivity • Example: The village is famous for its endeavor to eliminate poverty through cooperation. --- ❤️ Dear EthioFresh Family! Unit 3 Vocabulary & Terminology Masterclass is now complete. Happy studying and best of luck! 🙏✨
